answer_1.quote: our work focuses on open-ended knowledge graph question answering (KGQA), where LLMs are aimed to generate detailed answers that include explicit reasoning paths and supporting facts derived from the KG
answer_1.outputs: paragraph-long answers with explicit reasoning paths and supporting facts

answer_2.quote: We quantify LLM hallucinations using two public metrics: FActScore and SAFE. In addition to the hallucination metrics, we propose four metrics using LLM-as-evaluator to quantify the quality of generated responses from LLM.

answer_3.quote: we use G-Eval framework for the evaluation and provide relevant Wikipedia pages of each query as context to enhance G-Eval's robustness and stability. The four metrics are defined as follows: (1) Context Relevance: ... (2) Comprehensiveness: ... (3) Correctness: ... (4) Empowerment: ...

answer_4.quote: we also collect human evaluations for these 100 samples. Three expert annotators rate each anonymized response on context relevance, comprehensiveness, correctness, and empowerment, following the same criteria as the LLM evaluator.
